summary.text: Sherri Gallick is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 62, who assumed office on January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Gallick has a career background in agriculture, supply chain, operations and finance.

paragraphs.text: Sherri Gallick was born in Kansas City, Missouri.
She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Missouri in 1982 and an MBA from Webster University in 1990.
Her career experience includes working in agriculture, business practices, operations, supply chain issues, logistics, management and finance.
Her listed affiliations include the Missouri Cattlemen's Association, the Farm Bureau, the Cass County Republican Party and the Belton Chamber of Commerce.
In the Missouri House, Gallick chaired the House Economic Development Committee for 2025-2026.
